We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for the described facts.

Facts: In Jiangsu province, defendant used illegal electric fishing method during closed season, captured 0.37 kg fish. Also voluntarily released fish seedlings worth 1500 yuan for ecological restoration.

The illegal act: Using prohibited electric fishing during closed season violates fisheries law. In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "非法捕捞水产品罪" (illegal fishing of aquatic products) or "非法捕捞水产品罪" (illegal fishing). The correct label from earlier examples: For illegal capture of fish, they used "非法捕捞水产品". In earlier example: "非法捕捞水产品" was used for Yang1 case (fishing). Indeed earlier: "A: 非法捕捞水产品". So the correct charge is "非法捕捞水产品". Also there may be "非法捕捞水产品罪". The label used in examples: "非法捕捞水产品". So we output that.

Is there any other charge? The voluntary release of fish seedlings is mitigating, not a crime. So only one charge.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法捕捞水产品<eoa>
